labelDescriptions.type:feature: A request, idea, or new user-facing functionality or behavior.
labelDescriptions.type:bug: An unexpected problem or incorrect behavior.
labelDescriptions.type:hotfix: An urgent fix using the manual release path.
labelDescriptions.type:style: Formatting or style changes without behavior changes.
labelDescriptions.type:refactor: Code restructuring with no behavioral changes, feature additions, or bug fixes.
labelDescriptions.type:build: Changes to the build system or external dependencies.
labelDescriptions.type:chore: Concrete maintenance or operational work that is not a bug, feature, documentation change, or spike.
labelDescriptions.type:breaking: The PR title declares a breaking change with !.
labelDescriptions.auto:release-pr: Pull request created or managed as a package release.
labelDescriptions.auto:new-contributor: Author is a first-time contributor to this repository.
labelDescriptions.auto:trusted-contributor: Author satisfies the repository's trusted-contributor criteria.
labelDescriptions.org:external: Issue or pull request created by someone outside the `langchain-ai` GitHub organization.
labelDescriptions.org:internal: Issue or pull request created by a member of the `langchain-ai` GitHub organization.
labelDescriptions.org:open-swe: Pull request created from an `open-swe/` branch.
labelDescriptions.package:deepagents: Changes related to the `deepagents` SDK and agent harness.
labelDescriptions.package:dcode: Changes related to the `deepagents-code` terminal coding agent.
labelDescriptions.package:acp: Changes related to the Agent Client Protocol package.
labelDescriptions.package:talon: Changes related to the Talon package.
labelDescriptions.package:evals: Changes related to the evaluation suite, benchmarks, and Harbor integration.
labelDescriptions.package:examples: Changes to example code or tutorials.
labelDescriptions.integration:daytona: Integration with the Daytona sandbox service.
labelDescriptions.integration:modal: Integration with the Modal sandbox service.
labelDescriptions.integration:quickjs: Integration with the QuickJS sandbox package.
labelDescriptions.integration:runloop: Integration with the Runloop sandbox service.
labelDescriptions.integration:langsmith: Integration with LangSmith sandbox and related LangSmith services.
labelDescriptions.size: XS: Pull request with an extra-small diff.
labelDescriptions.size: S: Pull request with a small diff.
labelDescriptions.size: M: Pull request with a medium diff.
labelDescriptions.size: L: Pull request with a large diff.
labelDescriptions.size: XL: Pull request with an extra-large diff.
